```{r}
#| label: 'setup'
#| purl: true
# The preprocessed data used for calibration
DATA_ID <- setNames("loess_norm", nm = "LOESS normalization")

# Load packages and project local libraries
options(box.path = "code/")           # Path to project local libraries
box::use(
  SumExp,           # Light SummarizedExperiment, `[`
  projlib/msdial,     # Handle MS-Dial files
  projlib/show,       # Functions to present data
  projlib/io,       # Check input/output files
  patchwork,           # Combine ggplot objects. `+`
  ggplot2[...],        # Too long to write and usually specific enough
  ggfortify,           # PCA plot (autoplot)
)
# Read `params.yml` if `params` not provided
if (! exists("params")) params <- yaml::read_yaml("params.yml")

# Input/Output files
FILE <- list(
  i = rlang::list2(
    proc = msdial$get_sumexp_file_name(params, "proc"),
    qc = msdial$get_sumexp_file_name(params, "qc_steps"),   # Intermediate state of the data
  )
)
# Check if input files and output directories exist
io$check_io_exist(FILE)

concn_se <- readRDS(FILE$i$proc)[[DATA_ID]]
chem_ids <- SumExp::rownames(concn_se)[1:2]
# Load the intermediate data during QC
qc_steps <- readRDS(FILE$i$qc)
stopifnot("Preprocessing was not completed." = qc_steps[["Preprocessed"]])
# Conversion tables
sample_id_name_tbl <- qc_steps[["sample_id_name_tbl"]]
chem_id_name_tbl <- qc_steps[["chem_id_name_tbl"]]
```

# General overview

## PCA

```{r}
#| label: 'pca'
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
#| out-width: '100%'

plot_pca <- function(se, mat_id) {
  mat <- t(se[[mat_id]])
  mat <- mat[, colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]       # Scale is not possible with all zeros
  mat <- mat[, apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]        # Remove constant rows
  pca_res <- stats::prcomp(mat, scale. = TRUE)
  
  se_df <- SumExp::col_df(se)      # `data` in ggplot2::autoplot
  # Plot
  lab <- labelled::label_attribute(se[[mat_id]])
  ggplot2::autoplot(pca_res, data = se_df, colour = "Class") +
    labs(title = lab)
}
# plot_pca(concn_se[, quote(proc_cat != "QC")], "conc")
```

## Chemical summary

```{r}
#| label: 'chems'

chems <- SumExp::row_df(concn_se) |> 
  tibble::as_tibble(rownames = "chem_id")
mat <- concn_se[["conc"]]
# Summary about the concentration ranges
conc_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  chem_id = chems$chem_id,
  llod = chems$llod,
  df_n = sapply(1:nrow(mat), \(i) sum(mat[i, ] > llod[i])),
  df_perc = df_n / ncol(mat) * 100,
  median = apply(mat, 1, median),
  mean = rowMeans(mat),
  min = apply(mat, 1, min),
  max = apply(mat, 1, max),
)
conc_summary <- conc_summary |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    df_perc = scales::percent(df_perc / 100),
    median = round(median, 2),
    mean = round(mean, 2),
    min = round(min, 2),
    max = round(max, 2)
  )
# Summary about the calibration curve models
model_summary <- qc_steps[[DATA_ID]][["calcurve_models"]] |> 
  lapply(\(m) {
    type <- m$best_model_name
    R2 <- round(m$R2s[[type]], 3)
    n_conc <- m$n_conc
    data.frame(R2, type, n_conc) 
  }) |> 
  purrr::list_rbind(names_to = "chem_id")
# Merge
summary_tbl <- list(
  chems[, c("chem_id", "chem_name")],
  conc_summary,
  model_summary
) |> 
  purrr::reduce(dplyr::full_join, by = "chem_id") |> 
  dplyr::select(-chem_id)

# Summary table
summary_tbl |> 
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Summary of chemicals",
    col.names = c(
      "Chemical",
      "LLOD",
      "DF", 
      "DF (%)",
      "Median",
      "Average",
      "Min",
      "Max",
      "R2",
      "Model",
      "N of points"
    ),
  ) |> 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE, 
    repeat_header_continued = TRUE,
  ) |> 
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general = "DF: Detection frequency (number of samples above LLOD)",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )
```

# Invidual chemicals

{{< pagebreak >}}

```{r}
calcurve_se <- qc_steps[[DATA_ID]][["calcurve_se within range"]]
calcurve_models <- qc_steps[[DATA_ID]][["calcurve_models"]]
for(chem_i in chem_ids) {
  chem_name <- chem_id_name_tbl$chem_name[chem_id_name_tbl$chem_id == chem_i]
  cat("\n\n## ", chem_name, "\n")
  
  x_se <- concn_se[rownames(concn_se) == chem_i, quote(! proc_cat %in% c("QC", "Blank"))]
  cc_se <- calcurve_se[rownames(calcurve_se) == chem_i, ]
  # Calibration curve
  p1 <- show$ggplot_calcurve_samples(x_se, cc_se, calcurve_models, mat_id = DATA_ID) +
    labs(y = "Peak area (Normalized)")
  print(p1)
  print(p1 + scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10())
  cat("\n\n{{< pagebreak >}}\n\n")
}
```
